title: Mack Anthem hi-tensile Custom Built FUPS Bullbar #33
description: Mack Anthem hi-tensile custom built aluminium FUPS Bullbar. High tensile aluminium contoured main channel. Cow catcher with 4 small uprights, 381mm deep maim channel. High tensile 88mm diameter heavy duty 6mm wall pipe (optional 100 dia pipe available on request). Heavy duty tow pin and high tensile aluminium backing plate. 170x90mm high tensile aluminium main box uprights extended to the cow catcher bar. Driving light or light bar mounts fitted to customer requirements. Mack logo engraved in end plates. Net weight of bar is 149kgs. The bar sits 230mm from front of grill to the front of the bar.
